component.subject: The Law
component.title: Reading of the Law
component.source: 2 Corinthians 9:7 (World English Bible); "each man ... he ... his heart" rendered "each person ... they ... their hearts".

original.p: 2 Corinthians 9:7 (WEB): Let each man give according as he has determined in his heart; not grudgingly, or under compulsion; for God loves a cheerful giver.

block.p: Let each person give according as they have determined in their hearts, not grudgingly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.
